grants_phd_evidence.quote: The Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago offers a graduate program leading to a doctorate in computer science

programs.phd_evidence_quote: To complete the PhD program a student must make an original and significant contribution to the field of computer science described in a PhD thesis.
programs.notes: Single PhD program in computer science. Jinbo Xu listed on the faculty page as 'Professor' ('PhD - University of Waterloo'). Program page: 'Every TTIC student has a primary advisor among the Institute's tenure-track faculty' and students may collaborate with University of Chicago researchers.
